source.description: Where an adopted secret came from: the input secret the installation delivers, or a stored record that had been reported orphaned and came back.

created.description: When the stored secret was made (RFC 3339).

overlap_seconds.description: How long the replaced secret stays accepted; 0 is a hard cut.

previous_valid_until.description: When the replaced secret stops being accepted (RFC 3339); absent after a hard cut.

discarded_previous.description: The rotation was made while an earlier overlap was still open, so that older secret stopped being accepted.

orphaned.description: When the stored secret was first found without a generated client in the policy (RFC 3339).
